parameters.name: AppInfos
parameters.description: The information about applications related to the lane.

parameters.name: EnableRules
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the throttling rule.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the lane group.

parameters.name: LogicalRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the custom namespace. The ID is in the `physical region ID:custom namespace identifier` format. Example: `cn-hangzhou:test`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas insert-swimming-lane --logical-region-id cn-beijing:test --name test1 --tag tag --group-id 95 --entry-rules priority_:1,_path_:_/traffic_,_condition_:_AND_,_restItems_:_type_:_header_,_name_:_testheader_,_value_:_testvalue_,_cond_:_==_,_operator_:_rawvalue --enable-rules true --app-infos appId_:_f72deaac-26ba-429a-948d-5fa47c4a0000_,_appId_:_5049d2c8-f997-4fc9-92a2-153506a60000 --region cn-hangzhou
